sentence: This project builds tools that link how cells behave together to gene expression, using standard lab equipment and single-cell sequencing kits.
This project works toward a test on self-collected samples that finds Latina women at high risk of cervical cancer.
This project studies how maternal transcription factors and epigenetic regulators reprogram the genome of the early embryo after fertilization in Xenopus.
This project studies RNA viruses in the human virome by analyzing them very deeply.
This project develops a therapeutic approach based on synthetic lethality to suppress cancer growth and drug resistance.
This project builds a device that uses airway resistance feedback and machine learning to adjust pressure waves that help clear mucus.
This project builds methods to discover causal mechanisms in the brain, testing whether the frequency domain or the time domain works better.
This project studies stigma, HIV prevention and HIV care among Black and Latino trans women and men who have sex with men.
This project studies how a type of fusion protein changes DNA repair and genome stability in acute myeloid leukemia.
This project uses DNA nanotechnology to build tension probes and nanodevices that help explain how T cells send signals and switch on.
This project tests whether behavior screening in freshwater planarians can show how chemicals affect the developing nervous system.
This project tries to find genes that cause mutation rates to vary within species and among tissues.
This project builds stem cell models from donors of diverse populations to study the molecular causes of genetic risk for tauopathy.
This project studies the neural circuits behind habit formation and motor skill acquisition, and how faults in them may contribute to addiction.
This project builds an AI system that grades prostate cancer automatically to help judge early risk in Black men.
This project studies how a protein called oleate hydratase interacts with bacterial membranes to reach and change fatty acids.
This project studies how calcium signaling works in a model plant.
This project builds a framework that explains how AI models classify tumors from histopathological images, using counterfactual explanations.
This project builds technology to image an essential neuromodulator at synapses in awake behaving animals and studies its role in cortical sound processing.
This project studies how the spindle is positioned during cell divisions and how flexible control of this positioning works.
